title: M³oralBench: A MultiModal Moral Benchmark for LVLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces M³oralBench, which is explicitly designed to evaluate the moral understanding, classification, and reasoning of large vision-language models based on the Moral Foundations Theory (MFT). It measures model performance across six specific moral foundations such as Care/Harm, Fairness/Cheating, and Sanctity/Degradation.
